Addenda <Presidential Decree No. 24427, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Public Officials Following Transfer of Functions)
Following the transfer of functions to assist in the performance of duties relating to national security, 12 public officials belonging to the Office of the President as at the time this Decree enters into force (four senior civil servants, three officials of Grade III or IV, three officials of Grade IV or V, and two officials of Grade VI or below) shall be deemed public officials belonging to the Office of National Security and shall be transferred from the Office of the President to the Office of National Security.
